newsitem.title: UK: Russian seaborne crude exports fall in Oct - Petrak.
newsitem.headline: Russian seaborne crude exports fall in Oct - Petrak.

text.p: Russian seaborne crude exports fell slightly in October from September as lower shipments from Novorossiisk, Ventspils and Odessa more than cancelled out higher volumes from Tuapse, shipping inspectors Petrak said on Tuesday.

Crude exports from the four ports in October totalled 1.216 million barrels per day (bpd), 31,000 bpd fewer than in September and nearly 17,000 bpd below the average for the first 10 months of 1996, Petrak said.
Russia's leading Black Sea port of Novorossiisk shipped 693,436 bpd in October against 701,795 bpd in September.
Odessa shipped 163,068 bpd, down 18,270 bpd on September, while Tuapse saw exports rise from 61,650 bpd to 106,332 bpd in October.
October exports from the Latvian Baltic port of Ventspils totalled 253,084 bpd, sharply lower than the 302,092 bpd in September, Petrak said.
